item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US stocks tumble after Fed leaves interest rates unchanged
item.description: U.S. stocks closed sharply lower on Wednesday after the Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] France battles worst wildfire disaster in decades as blazes spread across Europe
item.description: France is battling what officials are calling the worst wildfire disaster since World War II, with the largest blaze burning near Bordeaux at roughly four times the size of Paris.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Local doctor suggests now is the time to start back-to-school sleep routines for kids
item.description: Dr. Ortiz is a sleep medicine physician at Johns Hopkins All Children's Hospital and said kids don’t need a strict sleep schedule just yet, but they do need to start reigning it in.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump asks Supreme Court to toss $83M defamation verdict in E. Jean Carroll case
item.description: President Donald Trump and the Justice Department are asking the Supreme Court to toss an $83 million defamation verdict won by writer E. Jean Carroll after she accused him of sexual assault.

item.description: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission is banning imports of new foreign-made humanoid robots and power inverters, citing national security risks, in a move that targets China. Beijing quickly accused the U.S. of protectionism.
